en.headline: Medical Association says flu activity remains high, urges early vaccination
en.dek: Hong Kong has been in the influenza season since late June; the 2026-27 vaccination programme starts on Thursday and the association advises people to get the shot ahead of any further rise.
body: The Hong Kong Medical Association said on Monday that influenza activity has stayed at a high level since the season began at the end of June, and is expected to continue in the early weeks of the new school term.

The association noted that more than 2.03 million doses were given under last season’s programmes, with especially strong uptake among children and adolescents. It highlighted lower rates among people aged 50 to 64 and pregnant women.

The 2026-27 seasonal influenza vaccination programme begins on Thursday. The association said antibodies generally take about two weeks to develop and urged eligible people to be vaccinated promptly. The government has expanded a pilot scheme to help private doctors obtain more vaccine doses.

zh.headline: 醫學會：流感活躍度仍高 籲盡早接種疫苗
zh.dek: 本港自6月底進入流感季節，活躍程度維持高水平，2026至27年度接種計劃周四展開，醫學會呼籲市民盡早打針。
body: 香港醫學會周一表示，本港自6月底進入流感季節以來，活躍程度在7月至8月中持續上升，目前仍維持高水平，開學初期社區傳播風險增加。
醫學會指，上年度各項流感疫苗接種計劃合共接種超過203萬劑，兒童及青少年接種率較突出，但50至64歲人士及孕婦接種率仍然偏低。
2026至27年度季節性流感疫苗接種計劃將於本周四展開。醫學會提醒接種後一般需約兩星期產生抗體，呼籲市民在高峰前及早接種。政府亦擴大醫生疫苗採購先導計劃，協助更多私家醫生取得疫苗。
